ar.title: بيض تركي مع السبانخ والجبنة البيضاء

steps.n1: تُغسل السبانخ عدة مرات وتُصفى في مصفاة وتُقطع بخشونة.
steps.n2: يُقلى البصل في الزيت حتى يصير ناعماً.
steps.n3: تُضاف السبانخ وتُحرك على نار متوسطة حتى تذبل الأوراق وتطلق سائلها.
steps.n4: تُرفع النار وتُطهى حتى يبقى سائل يغطي قاع المقلاة فقط.
steps.n5: تُضاف الجبنة المفتتة والملح والفلفل وتُحرك.
steps.n6: تُنزلق البيضات على السبانخ متباعدة، تُغطى المقلاة وتُطهى على نار متوسطة حتى تتماسك البيضات.

en.title: Turkish Eggs on Spinach and Feta (Ispanaklı Yumurta)
en.intro: Recipe 66, page 30 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

steps.n1: Wash the spinach in several changes of water, drain it in a colander and shred it coarsely.
steps.n2: Fry the onion in the oil until it softens.
steps.n3: Add the spinach and stir over a medium heat until the leaves wilt and release their liquid.
steps.n4: Turn up the heat and cook until only enough liquid is left to cover the bottom of the pan.
steps.n5: Stir in the crumbled cheese, salt and pepper.
steps.n6: Break the eggs onto the spinach, spacing them evenly, cover the pan and cook over a medium heat until the eggs are set.

legacySteps: Wash the spinach in several changes of water, drain it in a colander and shred it coarsely.
Fry the onion in the oil until it softens.
Add the spinach and stir over a medium heat until the leaves wilt and release their liquid.
Turn up the heat and cook until only enough liquid is left to cover the bottom of the pan.
Stir in the crumbled cheese, salt and pepper.
Break the eggs onto the spinach, spacing them evenly, cover the pan and cook over a medium heat until the eggs are set.
